description:
### Gboard Pro Patches (v2.1.1)

* **Rebased onto Gboard 18.6.3**: Updated core base package to official Google Gboard 18.6.3 (18.6.3.1002251336-release-arm64-v8a, versionCode: 176071768) matching PixelBoard 1.3.6 upstream parity
* **Candidate Strip Emoji Slot Placement**: Positions suggested emoji candidates on the right side of the candidate strip (Slot 2 for a standard 3-slot strip), allowing raw verbatim text and predictive autocompletions to occupy the left and center slots
* **Safe Keypress & Cursor Drag Haptic Feedback**: Explicitly passes FLAG_IGNORE_GLOBAL_SETTING on keypress and cursor drag haptics, guaranteeing consistent tactile feedback across Honor MagicOS, Huawei EMUI, and devices with system-wide vibration disabled
* **Screen Rotation Grace Period for Rambler Voice Dictation**: Extends orientation change grace period to 2500ms with a 1000ms baseline delay, tracking display rotation changes to keep voice dictation active without interruption across flips and rotations
* **Speech Diff Preservation & Microsoft Word / Office Fix**: Retains speech diffs for voice replacements and mid-sentence voice edits, while automatically adapting for Microsoft Word and Office apps to prevent cursor desynchronization
* **Header Minimize Key Positioning**: Relocates the Rambler minimize key next to the close key on the left side of the header (start extra key slot), keeping both Close and Minimize easily accessible
* **Rambler Stock Policy & Cursor Awareness**: Enforces jetson_enable_cursor_awareness flag in stock phenotype policy for improved voice editing precision
* **AI Writing Tools Connectivity & Limit Enforcement**: Enforces a 2000-word input limit for Proofread and Rewrite, updates candidate threshold to 0.0, enables proofread supported apps allowlist, and forces v2 landscape layout
* **Android 10+ (API 29) Minimum SDK Compatibility**: Sets minSdkVersion to 29, resolving package parser errors and enabling installation on Android 10 and Android 11 devices
* **Gboard Pro Dynamic Appearance Themes**: Includes Blush Lilac, Cotton Candy, Sunset Peach, Fresh Mint, and AMOLED Black pure dark mode
* **Enhanced Clipboard Retention & 100-Item Cap**: Unpinned clips retained for 24 hours by default, recent clip cap raised to 100, and discrete retention slider (1h, 2h, 3h, 6h, 12h, 18h, 24h)
* **Material 3 Expressive Design**: Expressive rounded pill keycaps, typography enhancements, and Material 3 About interface
* **Background Auto-Update Checks**: Background update checker checking GitHub releases at 8-hour intervals
* **Standalone Coexistence**: Side-by-side installation with official Gboard without root requirement

Supports Gboard v18.6.3 (Release), v18.5.3 (Release), v18.4.1 (Release), and v18.3.1 (Release / Beta).

release_notes:
## Gboard Pro v2.2.0 (Beta 3)

### What's New & Fixed
- **Classic Material UI Default**: Restored clean Material 3 / Material You UI as the default experience across Settings, Pro, About, Help & feedback, Additional, and Updates (switchable anytime to **3D Liquid Glass UI** under **Additional -> Choose UI**).
- **Dark Mode Water-Drop Liquid Glass Orbs**: Upgraded Dark Mode and AMOLED liquid glass orb highlights, dome speculars, wet glints, caustic bounces, and Fresnel rims to match Light Mode's 3D water-drop look.
- **60fps Performance & Transitions**: Added in-memory theme/palette caching, vsync-coalesced restyling, and smooth hardware-accelerated animations when opening **Languages -> + Add keyboard**.
- **Beta Program**: Added **Additional -> Beta Program** with **Beta version testing** (pre-release notice, real-time animated beta APK downloader, emoji-free testing feature notes, and beta-only bug reporting with up to 5 screenshots) and **New features (Beta)** toggle.
- **Notification Controls**: Added **Additional -> Notification** with separate controls for App Update Notifications (on/silent), Beta Testing APK Notifications (on/silent), and Beta Features Notifications.
